remarks: Spacious home on a generous 3/4-acre lot in the heart of Frewsburg. Set on a gorgeous tree-lined lot, this home captures the feeling of country living right in the cozy suburbs. On the back of the house is an oversized family room that would be great for entertaining. Inside, the main floor features a formal dining room and a roomy eat-in, country kitchen offering clever hidden storage drawers in the baseboards and a fireplace. The living room also has a fireplace, built-in storage, and recessed lighting. The family room features another fireplace and baseboard heat, but also banks of windows that look out over the backyard, bringing in natural light and a touch of the outdoors. There is a first-floor bedroom that could also serve as an office or hobby space. The main floor offers a full bath and a convenient laundry room. Upstairs, there is another full bath and two more bedrooms. The primary bedroom has two large walk-in closets. One of the closets shares a wall with the other bedroom, and that wall could potentially be removed to split the other bedroom into two. The home is equipped with central A/C and forced air heat for year-round comfort. Outside, the detached garage has three work bays and workshop space available.
